description: This file defines the main TodoPage widget for a Flutter-based to-do list application. It includes UI components such as header, list of todos, FAB for adding new todos, and filtering options. It also contains logic for displaying and editing todos via modal bottom sheets, managing state with Provider, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: TodoPage
classes.description: Main widget representing the entire to-do list screen.

classes.name: _TodoPageState
classes.description: State class for TodoPage, managing widget state and interactions.

methods.name: _showTodoEditor
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet for creating or editing a to-do item.
